about: Main camera of the pit village street set (street.glb). Blender space is z-up; three.js space is y-up: positions convert as (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y); the camera quaternion converts as q_three = rotation(-90 degrees about x) * q_blender, because a camera looks down its own -z with +y up in both. (For ordinary objects the glTF exporter instead writes (w, x, z, -y), since their vertices are converted too.) The camera is also inside street.glb as the node "main_camera" (and "side_camera", 2 m to the right).

set_notes.ground_height_formula: z = min(y, 76) * tan(4 deg) (channel line); pavement top = that + 0.13; road crown + 0.08
set_notes.winding_wheels: nodes winding_wheel_left and winding_wheel_right, each with its origin on its own axle and no rotation; the axles run along Blender y, which is three.js -z, so turn them with wheel.rotation.z in three.js (rotation_euler y in Blender). The wheels face the camera; ropes are a separate static object (winding_ropes).
set_notes.markers: empties: lamp_0..lamp_4 (lamp heads), <row>_cottage_NN_doorway, <row>_cottage_NN_chimney_top, chimney_smoke_top (colliery chimney), wheel_left_axle, wheel_right_axle, engine_house_door
set_notes.glowing_material_names: window_lit_glow_0..2 (lit cottage windows), engine_window_glow, lamp_glass_glow, sky_dome_glow
